name: Surya
tagline: Multilingual document OCR and layout analysis toolkit supporting over 90 languages with line-level text detection.
real_test_summary: Tested running multilingual page layout detection and line-by-line OCR on scanned documents offline. Accurately separates headers, tables, and reading order without cloud APIs.
pros: Supports 90+ languages with strong layout and reading-order detection
Runs locally via CLI or Python API with no external calls
Pairs cleanly with Marker for structured PDF extraction
cons: Requires a dedicated GPU for fast batch processing of long documents
GPL-3.0 license requires compliance for proprietary redistribution
